title.narrative: Improving Livelihood and Access to Rural Areas in Guinea-Bissau

description.narrative:
UNOPS helps improve access to markets and socio-economic facilities for some of the most vulnerable populations in Guinea-Bissau, with the goal to facilitate the marketing of agricultural production and improve access to basic social services for rural populations in the Oio regions, Quinara and Tombali, through the sustainable rehabilitation of infrastructure transport.

With funding from the European Union, and in collaboration with the Government, the programme is set to rehabilitate around 78 km of rural roads, tracks and river crossings within regions of Oio, Quinara and Tombal.
